skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and grasp basic economic theories and concepts, as well as social and daily life issues.
Confidently discuss business and economic topics, and daily life issues; participate in conversations on familiar topics without preparation.
Read and understand texts containing clear information on basic economic topics and areas of interest.
Write simple essays on economic, business, and daily life topics.
Demonstrate proficiency in English grammar, vocabulary, and writing structures.
Prepare for IELTS and other international certification exams.
